location: Lý Thường kiệt, Hội An, TP. Đà Nẵng
content:
The project is inspired by the timeless charm of Hoi An, blending contemporary architecture with the distinctive character of its traditional heritage. Local architectural elements are thoughtfully reinterpreted to create a resort that offers modern comfort while celebrating the unique cultural identity of the region.

Designed to provide a peaceful and authentic hospitality experience, the project harmonizes with the surrounding streetscape, creating a welcoming retreat that reflects the spirit of Hoi An.
